concerns.text: Functional Requirements reference a non‑existent identifier ‘US‑1’ (e.g., FR‑001, FR‑002, FR‑003, FR‑004, FR‑005, FR‑006, FR‑007 each contain ‘(See US‑1)’). The specification only defines User Stories as ‘User Story 1’, ‘User Story 2’, etc., without a US‑1 label, causing a broken cross‑reference.

Constitution Principle VI mandates Spatial‑Topology Decoupling, requiring the spatial model to use geographic coordinates independent of the graph topology. FR‑011 (and FR‑001) mandate generating synthetic coordinates via Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) on the adjacency matrix, which derives distances directly from topology, thereby violating the decoupling principle and making it impossible to attribute observed effects solely to geographic proximity.
